A lengthy VAR review followed, testing the nerves of both sets of players, but the original decision stood. The equalizer breathed new life into the stadium, prompting Mikel Arteta to respond with a triple substitution that saw Bukayo Saka , Gabriel Jesus , and Leandro Trossard enter the fray. Following a VAR intervention, the referee overturned the penalty decision, much to the frustration of the Arsenal bench. In the final minutes of stoppage time, both sides searched for a winner.
